goals: Verify that the update workshop API successfully updates an existing workshop and returns a 200 status code with the updated data.
activities: Insert a new workshop test record and retrieve its ID
Prepare the update request body with modified workshop details
Send a PUT request to the update workshop API with the workshop ID and request body
Calculate the expected updated workshop state from the request body
Assert the HTTP status code is 200
Assert the response Content-Type header is application/json
Assert the response body status is 200
Assert the response body message indicates success
Assert the response body data matches the expected updated workshop state
Assert 'detail' is not present in the response body
Verify the updated workshop data in the database by ID
Clean the workshop test environment during teardown
